items.title: Experts discuss ways to bridge military needs & industrial capabilities
items.description: India-Israel defence dialogue at CII Chandigarh explored indigenisation, tech transfer, air defence, drones and AI to boost Atma-Nirbhar combat capability.

items.title: Shah presents President’s Police Colour to Chandigarh Police, unveils AI shield for city
items.description: Amit Shah awards President’s Police Colour to Chandigarh Police, unveils AI shield adding 2,152 cameras, flags 141 vehicles; highlights high conviction rates.
